title: Special inspection for smoke control.
officialText:
Smoke control systems shall be tested by a special inspector in accordance with
Sections 1704.15.1 and 909.
Exception: Post-fire smoke purge systems that are not required to function as a smoke control system shall be permitted to be
inspected pursuant to the special inspection requirements of Section 1704.16.
